codeBin.description: Override the VS Code CLI binary/path.

workspace.description: Folder/workspace to open when creating or activating the profile.

profileId.description: One internal profile folder name from list-profiles, never a path. Required for profile-file writes unless settingsFile is provided.

settingsFile.description: Explicit profile settings.json path. Can be used instead of profileId for profile-file writes.

settings.description: Profile settings to merge. Requires profileId or settingsFile when applying.

settingsMerge.description: Whether object-valued settings replace their prior value or are recursively merged.

removeSettings.description: Top-level profile setting keys to remove. Requires profileId or settingsFile when applying.

extensions.description: Marketplace extension IDs, optionally pinned with @version. Use the direct install command for VSIX files.

removeExtensions.description: Marketplace extension IDs to uninstall; applying requires --confirm-destructive.

keybindings.description: Complete keybindings.json content. Requires profileId or settingsFile when applying.

snippets.description: Snippet files keyed by filename, for example python.json or global.code-snippets. Requires profileId or settingsFile when applying.

tasks.description: Complete tasks.json content. Requires profileId or settingsFile when applying.

mcpServers.description: Named MCP server definitions to merge into the profile mcp.json servers object. Prefer env or input variables over literal secrets.

removeMcpServers.description: Named MCP servers to remove; applying requires --confirm-destructive.
